tables.name: waitlist_entries
tables.purpose: Tracks every shopper's expressed interest in a sold-out item, at variant or product level.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: shopper_email
columns.purpose: email address to notify

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the product the shopper is waiting on

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: null when the signup is at product level; set when shopper picked a specific variant

columns.name: scope
columns.purpose: whether the entry is tracked at variant or product level

columns.name: unsubscribe_token
columns.purpose: unique token embedded in every email's unsubscribe link; used to identify the shopper across all their entries

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: active, notified, or removed

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.purpose: set when tombstoned due to product deletion or unsubscribe

tables.name: notification_batches
tables.purpose: Represents one restock event for an item and tracks how many notifications have been queued and sent from it.

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: null when the batch is for a product-level waitlist

columns.name: available_quantity_at_restock
columns.purpose: quantity Shopify reported when the restock was detected

columns.name: notify_cap
columns.purpose: copy of the merchant setting at batch creation so historical batches remain accurate

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: open, completed, or cancelled

tables.name: notification_sends
tables.purpose: One row per shopper per batch — the atomic unit the email scheduler dispatches and the attribution anchor for conversions.

columns.name: batch_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the restock batch this send belongs to

columns.name: waitlist_entry_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES waitlist_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the waitlist entry being notified

columns.name: shopper_email
columns.purpose: denormalized for fast dispatch without a join

columns.name: queue_position
columns.purpose: signup-order position within the batch; enforces FIFO and notify-cap cutoff

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: queued, dispatched, failed, or skipped

tables.name: conversions
tables.purpose: Records when a notified shopper purchases the item within the 7-day attribution window.

columns.name: notification_send_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_sends(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the dispatched send credited with this conversion

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: the order that closed the attribution loop

tables.name: email_template
tables.purpose: Stores the merchant-configured email subject and body template with dynamic variable placeholders.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: singleton row — code enforces at most one row

columns.name: subject_template
columns.purpose: supports {{product_name}} and {{variant_label}} placeholders

columns.name: body_template
columns.purpose: supports {{product_name}}, {{variant_label}}, {{product_url}}, {{unsubscribe_url}} placeholders

tables.name: app_settings
tables.purpose: Stores merchant-configured operational parameters: quiet hours window and per-restock notification cap.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: singleton row — code enforces at most one row

columns.name: quiet_hours_start
columns.purpose: hour of day (0-23) at which sending is paused

columns.name: quiet_hours_end
columns.purpose: hour of day (0-23) at which sending resumes

columns.name: per_restock_notify_cap
columns.purpose: maximum shoppers to notify per restock batch; remainder waits for the next restock

tables.name: waitlist_snapshots
tables.purpose: Pre-aggregated per-product waitlist counts refreshed on every signup or removal, enabling instant-load dashboard ranking without full-table scans.

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the product this snapshot summarises

columns.name: product_title
columns.purpose: denormalized title fetched at first signup and refreshed on products/update; avoids live Shopify lookups on every dashboard render

widget.purpose: Return live availability for a product/variant so the widget decides whether to show the sign-up form.
Register a shopper's email on the waitlist for a sold-out item.
Check whether a given email is already on the waitlist for an item.
Remove a shopper from all their waitlist entries using the token from their email footer link.

admin.purpose: Return a paginated list of products ranked by active waitlist size.
Return a paginated list of individual subscribers for a specific product or variant.
Stream a CSV of all subscriber entries for a given product or variant.
Return the current email subject and body template for the editor.
Save an updated email subject and body template.
Return the current quiet-hours window and per-restock notify cap.
Save updated quiet-hours and notify-cap settings.
